source: DECISIONS.md Table 4 (S-01 to S-41) as written 2026-10-18, and W-29. Statuses are a copy: update a row's status here when Table 4 changes (for example when the Haiku pass applies S-01).
dialect: Python re. Matched per line. flags is '' or 'i'. FAIL = unambiguous stale value; WARN = needs a human.

exclude_reasons.build/: the plan and evidence quote the stale strings on purpose

exclude_reasons.ops/decisions.csv: generated mirror of DECISIONS.md, which quotes every stale value by design (deviation from the plan's list, which names ops/ whole)
exclude_reasons.tests/: test fixtures quote the stale strings on purpose
